title: A magnitude-7.4 earthquake in western Colombia leaves dozens dead and triggers landslides
summary: The quake, considered the largest in the area in a decade, toppled buildings and left at least 20 dead.

title: Yokohama eliminates defending champion Okinawa Shogaku at Koshien
summary: Starter Oda dominated with 12 strikeouts, and the offense sealed the matchup of spring and summer champions.

title: Tenri beats Fukuyama and advances to third round at the summer Koshien
summary: The Nara team prevailed with an early home run by Kanemoto and a four-run attack, earning their 80th victory in spring and summer tournaments.

title: Takagawa Gakuen overcomes Takaoka Sho at the summer Koshien
summary: Starter Kinoshita pitched a complete game, and Takagawa capitalized on six Takaoka errors to win 7-1.

title: Kumamoto earthquake keeps thousands evacuated and activates reconstruction
summary: Two weeks after the quake, subsidies for destroyed homes are announced, facilities reopen, and reconstruction proceeds with military support.

title: Yen falls to 159 per dollar, erasing half of the post-intervention rise
summary: The Japanese currency weakened due to the dollar's strength and Middle East tensions, following the coordinated intervention by Japan and the U.S.

title: Two children die after being swept away by waves at a Niigata beach
summary: Three family members were swept out to sea; two of the children died.

title: Typhoon 15 approaches Japan on an unusual path and disrupts transportation
summary: It is expected to make landfall in Fukushima or Ibaraki for the first time on record, with rain and winds disrupting services.

title: Chunichi Dragons coach Shima suffers traffic accident in Tokyo
summary: His vehicle collided with a cyclist in Koganei; the other person sustained minor injuries.

title: Japan studies remote access to phones to investigate anonymous criminal groups
summary: Police seek a new tool to analyze smartphones of 'tokuryu' and overcome their anonymity.

title: METI official suspended for transferring bank account to third parties
summary: The manager-level employee was sanctioned with a three-month suspension for illegally handing over a bankbook.

title: Court plays video of interrogation of former special prosecutor
summary: The hour-long recording included controversial statements and drew mixed reactions among those present.

title: 41 years after Japan Airlines accident, safety legacy lives on
summary: Commemorative reports remember the victims and warn that almost no employees who experienced the tragedy remain.
